verdict.rationale: The site lets users search registered entities by Filing ID or entity name (docs-4), and the WyoBiz portal's public Business Center page loads without logging in (probe-4). It also advertises online formation and an Annual Report Wizard (docs-6, docs-1). However, no published page says the core filing flow itself can be started without creating an account; the only file-number entry path shown is for search, not filing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that formation or annual-report filing begins without account creation, a documented file-number entry into the filing wizard, and hands-on confirmation beyond reaching the landing page.
